note: CC0 plant sprites for the garden's daily wild flora, from Kenney asset packs (https://kenney.nl). Fetched by tools/fetch-plants.mjs into www/assets/plants/. 'named': keep files whose names say they are plants; 'scan': numbered tiles, keep the ones that look like plants (cut-outs, mostly leaf-green or flowers on green). 'only' / 'skip' filter paths inside the zip.
